verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes are programmatic-first. The Python SDK documents creating sandboxes with images and volumes, running exec commands, filesystem access, snapshots, network allow-lists, GPU/CPU/memory settings and log fetch/tail, and an official CLI manages and connects to running containers. However, nothing documents parity with the dashboard. The JS/Go SDKs cover only "some" platform resources, and no public REST/OpenAPI spec was found (all candidate paths returned 404). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or a mapping of dashboard features to API calls, a public language-agnostic HTTP API spec, full platform coverage in the JS/Go SDKs, and independent confirmation of parity.
